sources.notes: A committed, one-time curated subset of the GeoNames Iran dump. It supplies point coordinates for province capitals and county seats; it is not part of the official administrative workbook and is not a centroid or polygon dataset.

identity_sources.notes: Used during one-time curation to cross-check county seat identities. The local V3 IDs and the committed coordinate CSVs are the build inputs.
Used as a semantic cross-check that a capital/seat is an administrative centre, not a geographic centroid.
